Strings.firewall.intro: Manage this host's firewall state, default policies and numbered rules.
Strings.firewall.login_required: Sign in to a RelaxKonOS Server to manage its firewall.
Strings.firewall.warning: Firewall changes can disconnect this RelaxKonOS session. Confirm your management access before applying a rule.
Strings.firewall.section.protection_hint: The host reports this state. Starting or stopping the firewall applies to the whole host.
Strings.firewall.section.defaults_hint: Policies decide what happens to traffic no rule matches. Nothing is written until you save.
Strings.firewall.section.rules_hint: Rules are numbered by the host. An update replaces a rule in place, so the order of the others stays stable.
Strings.firewall.section.safety_hint: This application never installs or replaces the firewall backend, and it never sends command text to the host.
Strings.firewall.protection.enable_hint: Starting the firewall applies every rule; connections that are not allowed are dropped.
Strings.firewall.protection.disable_hint: Stopping the firewall makes every rule inactive until it is started again.
Strings.firewall.defaults.unknown: The host did not report its default policies.
Strings.firewall.defaults.lockout_warning: Saving a deny default drops every connection the rules do not allow, including this management session.
Strings.firewall.rules.filter_hint: Filter by number, address, port or action
Strings.firewall.rules.select_one: Select a rule to read it back, or add a new one.
Strings.firewall.rules.empty: This host has no rule managed by RelaxKonOS. Add one, or keep the default policies and add nothing.
Strings.firewall.rules.filter_empty: The filter matches no rule on this host.
Strings.firewall.rule.help: Leave source, destination, or port blank for any; use a single port or a range such as 443 or 8000:8080.
Strings.firewall.rule.source_tooltip: Enter the client source address to match. Leave blank for any, or enter an IP or CIDR such as 192.0.2.10, 192.0.2.0/24, or 2001:db8::/32.
Strings.firewall.rule.destination_tooltip: Enter the host destination address to match. Leave blank for any, or enter an IP or CIDR such as 192.0.2.10, 192.0.2.0/24, or 2001:db8::/32.
Strings.firewall.editor.invalid_hint: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
Strings.firewall.validation.source_invalid: Source must be any or a valid IP/CIDR, such as 192.0.2.10, 192.0.2.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32.
Strings.firewall.validation.destination_invalid: Destination must be any or a valid IP/CIDR, such as 192.0.2.10, 192.0.2.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32.
Strings.firewall.validation.port_invalid: Enter a port from 1 to 65535, or a start:end range.
Strings.firewall.validation.protocol_port: The any protocol can only use the any port.
Strings.firewall.problem.ufw_not_installed: UFW is not installed on this host. This application does not install or replace the firewall backend.
Strings.firewall.problem.unsupported_platform: This host platform has no firewall backend this application can manage.
Strings.firewall.problem.invalid_rule: The host rejected this rule. Check the action, direction, protocol, address and port against the host policy.
Strings.firewall.problem.invalid_rule_number: That rule number no longer exists on the host. Refresh to read the current rules.
Strings.firewall.problem.invalid_default_policy: The host does not accept this default policy for its backend. Refresh to read the current policies.
Strings.firewall.problem.operation_failed: The host rejected the change. Refresh to read the current firewall state before trying again.
Strings.firewall.confirm.enable_message: Every rule starts applying immediately. Connections that are not allowed are dropped, including this management session if its port is not allowed.
Strings.firewall.confirm.disable_message: Every rule stops applying until the firewall is started again. The host is unprotected while it is off.
Strings.firewall.confirm.defaults_message: The host applies these policies to traffic no rule matches. {0}
Strings.firewall.confirm.delete_message: Rule {0} ({1}) is removed from the host immediately and cannot be restored.
Strings.firewall.status.windows_ready: Windows Firewall ready: state and defaults apply to Domain, Private and Public profiles; only rules managed by this app are listed.
Strings.firewall.read_only: This session can read the host firewall but cannot change it. Ask an administrator for the manage permission.
Strings.firewall.note.windows: On Windows the state and default policies apply to the Domain, Private and Public profiles together. Only rules this application manages are listed.
Strings.firewall.permission.read_required: Firewall access requires the Read firewall configuration permission.
Strings.firewall.permission.manage_required: Changing the firewall requires the Manage firewall configuration permission.
